string-array.name: hotkeys_list
string-array.item: Ctrl+R — Open the screenshot actions dialog (Copy/Save/Save and Open/Render at Custom Res) - same as the camera button
Ctrl+C — Copy the current frame to the clipboard immediately, skipping that dialog
Ctrl+F — Find Shader (shader list showing) or Find in Shader (cursor in the source editor)
Ctrl+S — Save Shader
Ctrl+V — Paste as New Shader
Ctrl+Shift+D — Open the Adjust Defines tool
Ctrl+PageUp / Ctrl+PageDown — Previous/Next pass tab (shaders with offscreen buffers)
Esc — Same as the back button
F11 — Toggle Fullscreen
Up — Play/Pause (outside the source editor)
Ctrl+Up — Rewind (outside the source editor)
Left / Right — Previous/Next Shader, respecting any active filter (outside the source editor)
Shift+Left — First Shader in the list, respecting any active filter (outside the source editor)
Shift+Right — Random Shader (outside the source editor)
Ctrl+Left / Ctrl+Right — Back/Forward through the last 20 shaders visited, browser-history-style, wrapping around at either end
Tab — Show/Hide the shader sidebar (outside the source editor)
Ctrl+Z — Undo
Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z — Redo
Ctrl+Shift+E — While Fullscreen: toggle the source editor and pause, to switch between snappy editing and a fullscreen view
Ctrl+Shift+R — Pause and open the quality picker dialog; picking one unpauses
Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- — One resolution quality step up/down (an increase on a slow shader still asks first)
Ctrl+Q — Quit (saves the current shader first if needed)
Enter (in Find Shader/Find in Shader) — Searches, then cycles through matches on each further press; Ctrl+Enter loads the currently shown match (Find Shader only)
Left/Right (in Find Shader) — Cycles through matches
